title: Run live round 1 for F and F-rand and take the first reading (S1)
description:
## Purpose

Run live round 1 for F and F-rand on Jev and take the first F vs F-rand reading (stop S1).

## Scope

Round 1 (100 labels) on dev-100, arms 0 (free), F and F-rand, one Jev request per item with the list in the state (Q2). F: 3 trial lists x the labels outside every list (offline: 3 x 78 = 234), then the chosen list over its own list items and dev-100 (offline: 122). F-rand: 100 labels + 100 dev = 200. A-c / A-c+F zero-shot work waits for L2 comments (Phase 2); design §5.3 lists them in round 1, the owner's phasing moves them. No paper-600.

## Cost cap

≈556 requests (offline twin of the command: F 356, F-rand 200; upper bound 700), ≈$0.36 at the few-shot estimate (Appendix C); **hard cap 1,000 Jev requests** for this step inside the 7,500 cumulative ledger. Pre-approved by the owner within these caps.

## Definition of done (S1)

Requests well-formed; F's list differs from F-rand's; the holistic answer with the list differs from zero-shot on about 20% of items (`list_vs_zero_shot` in the summary); token multiplier about 1.9× (ledger tokens per request); dev-100 F vs F-rand accuracy/Brier and actual spend posted as a comment; humans look before Phase 2 spend.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §3.2, §5.3, §6 step 5.
